text: PAX Assistance was co-founded by Alexia Keglevich, its CEO, together with the founding team of Turismocity.
short: PAX Assistance was co-founded by Alexia Keglevich and the Turismocity founders

source.name: Forbes Argentina: 'Cómo hizo Pax Assistance, cofundada por Alexia Keglevich, para facturar más de US$ 2 millones en solo 4 meses'
source.quote: Cómo hizo Pax Assistance, cofundada por Alexia Keglevich, para facturar más de US$ 2 millones
source.note: The article's body adds that the company 'fue co-fundada por Alexia junto al equipo fundador del grupo Turismocity' (was co-founded by Alexia together with the founding team of Turismocity) and describes Keglevich as 'CEO & Co-fundadora de Pax Assistance'.
